fleet.title: Cars & drivers
fleet.desc: One car equals one driver. Changing either vehicle quantity or the total keeps both synchronized.

customers.title: Customers & revenue
customers.desc: Enter contracted daily volume and the price your company receives for each delivery.

costs.title: Company costs
costs.desc: All monetary assumptions are here. Replace every default with your actual payroll, lease, fuel, and supplier costs.
costs.computedNote: Fuel and totals are calculated live from each row and match the model exactly.

daily.title: Daily operations report
daily.desc: Record actual deliveries, failures, attendance, and fuel. Planned figures remain separate from what you enter.
daily.savedMessage: Daily report saved in this browser.
daily.allocationNote: Allocated cost is monthly company cost ÷ 26 working days. Fuel is already included in allocated cost and shown separately for control—not added twice.
daily.exportHead: Share the daily report or inspect all inputs
daily.exportDesc: PDF contains this daily report. Excel includes summary, daily report, company costs, cars and drivers, and customers.
daily.noHistory: No actual daily reports saved yet.

risks.title: Risks
risks.desc: These flags are rules based on your entered numbers—not AI predictions.
risks.missingDetail: {{count}} vehicles have no company driver in the model.
risks.unitDetail: Scaling volume is unsafe while average revenue remains below total unit cost.

summary.title: Operations & financial overview
summary.subtitle: Useful operating indicators from your inputs. Dashed points are model projections; saved daily reports are actual records.
summary.trendAria: Fourteen day revenue and cost trend
summary.trendNote: Dashed line marks the daily break-even level (allocated cost). Days where revenue falls below it lose money. Save daily reports to replace projected revenue with recorded results.
summary.totalsHead: What the company costs each month
summary.detailToggle: View detailed model and risk explanation
summary.bizSubtitle: Current monthly result from the numbers entered in this app.

actionsPage.title: Follow-up
actionsPage.desc: A small working list for validating the model. Completed items stay for this session.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.desc: Save snapshots of the whole model, load them back, and compare outcomes side by side. Scenarios are stored in this browser.
scenarios.saveHead: Save current numbers as a scenario
scenarios.emptyHint: Adjust the model on the other pages, then save it here under a name. Loading a snapshot replaces every input with the saved values.
scenarios.backupHead: Move the whole model between devices
scenarios.backupDesc: The backup file contains your current inputs, daily reports, and saved scenarios as JSON.
scenarios.importFailed: Import failed: not a valid VEGA backup file.
scenarios.loadedMessage: Loaded "{{name}}" into the model. Review costs before relying on it.
scenarios.legacyNote: Legacy v1 file — upgraded automatically on import; recovery entries and actions were not stored in v1.
scenarios.keptInputsNote: Merge keeps your current model inputs — choose Replace to adopt the backup's inputs instead.
scenarios.previewStats: Merge plan: {{added}} will be added · {{updated}} updated · {{conflicts}} conflicts stay local (newest wins).
scenarios.replacedMessage: Data replaced from the backup dated {{date}}.

charts.waterfallHead: From monthly revenue to net result
charts.waterfallAria: Waterfall chart from revenue through cost groups to net result
charts.sensHead: Net margin % under fuel price and volume changes
charts.sensNote: Each cell recomputes the whole model. Green cells are profitable; deeper red means larger losses.

report.kindDesc: Standard is a one-page facts sheet. Pro adds charts, target tracking and insights.
report.confidential: Internal planning document — generated from the local VEGA model. Verify inputs before operational use.
report.chartDeliveryHead: Delivered vs missed against daily target
report.noDataBars: No days recorded in this window yet — bars appear as you save daily reports.
report.insightNoRecords: No daily reports saved in this window. Record deliveries to unlock trend insights.
report.insightSingleDay: Single recorded day — trends will sharpen as more days are logged.
report.insightAboveTarget: Delivered {{percent}}% above the plan across recorded days.
report.insightOnTarget: Delivery is on target with the plan.
report.insightBelowTarget: Delivered {{percent}}% below plan: {{delivered}} of {{target}} planned shipments.
report.insightMissRateWatch: Miss rate {{rate}}% is worth watching — investigate recurring failure reasons.
report.insightMissRateHigh: High miss rate {{rate}}% with {{missed}} missed shipments — escalate to operations.
report.insightFuelOverModel: Fuel spend {{amount}} SAR exceeds the model day ({{expected}} SAR) — check routes or idling.
report.insightDriverShortfall: Only {{present}} of {{total}} drivers were present on the focus day.
report.insightLossDay: The focus day closed at a loss of {{amount}} SAR.
report.missReasonsDesc: Break the failed count into causes — this is what turns the report into decisions.
report.reasonsMismatch: {{count}} failed shipments entered but reasons add up to {{sum}}.
report.reasonsOk: Reasons reconcile with the failed count.
report.noMissesLogged: No missed shipments logged in this window.
report.narrativeLead: Across {{days}} recorded day(s) the fleet delivered {{delivered}} of {{target}} planned shipments.
report.narrativeTargetGap: {{short}} shipments short of plan ({{percent}}% below target).
report.narrativeMissReasons: {{missed}} shipments were missed ({{rate}}% of attempts); the dominant cause accounts for {{reasonCount}} cases ({{reasonPercent}}%).
report.narrativeNoMisses: Every attempted shipment was delivered — zero misses recorded.
report.narrativeFuelLine: Fuel spend: {{amount}} SAR against a model day of {{expected}} SAR.
report.narrativeExtrasLine: Unplanned costs of {{amount}} SAR were logged.
report.narrativeVisitsLine: {{visits}} customer visit(s) completed for commercial follow-up.
report.insightTopMissReason: "{{reason}}" is the top miss cause with {{count}} cases ({{percent}}%) — fix this first.
report.insightExtraCosts: Unplanned costs reached {{amount}} SAR — above the alert threshold.
report.insightVisitsLogged: {{visits}} customer visits logged — keep the commercial pipeline moving.
report.nextDayFocusPlaceholder: What must happen tomorrow? Priorities, recoveries, maintenance…
report.insightIncidents: {{count}} safety incident(s) recorded today — investigate before next dispatch.
report.customerBreakdownDesc: Attribute today's delivered and missed shipments per customer — powers the scorecards in reports.
report.insightCustomerMisses: "{{name}}": {{rate}}% of {{attempts}} attempts missed — review pricing or service for this account.
report.insightPodGap: Proof of delivery incomplete today — dispute and payment-delay risk.
report.paymentsLine: Payments: {{cash}} COD vs {{prepaid}} prepaid shipments; {{amount}} SAR cash collected.

recovery.recoveryDesc: Every missed shipment gets an owner and an outcome. Nothing falls through the cracks.
recovery.emptyBoard: No recovery entries yet. When a delivery fails, log it here so it gets an owner.
